app.title: Walgit – a Git server that is one binary in front of an object store
app.author: matallo
app.description: A lightweight Git server that stores repositories in an object store, exposing a standard Git protocol.
proposed_tests: Download the latest release binary and start the server with a local object store backend
Clone a test repository using git clone and push a commit to verify persistence
Run a git fetch from a second clone to confirm replication
Measure the time taken to push and fetch a 1MB file
Check the server logs for any error messages during operation
